~~~{=html}
<div class="refraction-layers-lab" data-refraction-layers
     role="group" aria-label="Фаза световой волны в прозрачном слое">
  <div class="refraction-layers-lab__controls">
    <label>Показатель преломления, \(n\)
      <span data-index-value>1.08</span>
      <input type="range" data-index min="1" max="1.2" step="0.005" value="1.08">
    </label>
    <label>Толщина слоя, \(L/\lambda_0\)
      <span data-length-value>1.50</span>
      <input type="range" data-length min="0.05" max="3" step="0.05" value="1.5">
    </label>
  </div>
  <svg viewBox="0 0 1200 395" role="img"
       aria-label="Сравнение волны, прошедшей через слой, с волной в вакууме">
    <rect class="refraction-layers-lab__medium" data-medium x="442.5" y="35" width="315" height="260"></rect>
    <line class="refraction-layers-lab__axis" x1="70" y1="165" x2="1130" y2="165"></line>
    <path class="refraction-layers-lab__vacuum" data-vacuum-wave></path>
    <path class="refraction-layers-lab__wave" data-medium-wave></path>
    <line class="refraction-layers-lab__boundary" data-entry x1="442.5" y1="35" x2="442.5" y2="295"></line>
    <line class="refraction-layers-lab__boundary" data-exit x1="757.5" y1="35" x2="757.5" y2="295"></line>
    <text x="177" y="335" text-anchor="middle">вакуум</text>
    <text x="600" y="335" text-anchor="middle">вещество</text>
    <text x="1023" y="335" text-anchor="middle">вакуум</text>
    <line class="refraction-layers-lab__key-vacuum" x1="330" y1="374" x2="380" y2="374"></line>
    <text x="394" y="381">без слоя</text>
    <line class="refraction-layers-lab__key-medium" x1="650" y1="374" x2="700" y2="374"></line>
    <text x="714" y="381">со слоем</text>
  </svg>
  <p class="refraction-layers-lab__readout" aria-live="polite">
    Добавочная фаза на выходе:
    <span data-phase-value>0.75</span> рад.
    Частота по обе стороны слоя одинакова.
  </p>
</div>
~~~
